column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the CI scan of the running stack (plan 8.2).
# Format, one rule per line, tab-separated:   <rule id>
# Every passive rule not listed here is WARN, and in CI a WARN fails the job:
# zap-baseline.py runs without -I, so any alert stops the Docker Build check.
# To accept an alert instead of fixing it, add an IGNORE line. The line
# directly above it must be a comment starting "# disposition:" that says, in
# the maintainer's words, why the alert does not apply or is accepted, and who
# accepted it. backend/tests/test_ci_zap_baseline.py enforces that, and keeps
# the security-header rules from ever being ignored.

# disposition: Low risk, accepted by Mark Almeida-Cardy 2026-11-15. The Server header shows nginx/1.31.8. That only helps someone pick a CVE to try, and the defence is keeping the nginx image patched, not hiding the version.

column3: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field

column1: # disposition: Accepted by Mark Almeida-Cardy 2026-11-15. COOP is set to same-origin-allow-popups on purpose so the Google sign-in popup works (nginx.conf:165), and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy is not set. The Spectre-style cross-origin leak this rule covers is accepted as low risk for a self-hosted, single-origin app.

column3: Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre Vulnerability

column1: # disposition: Accepted by Mark Almeida-Cardy 2026-11-15. The CSP allows img-src https: and style-src 'unsafe-inline'. Neither one can run script: script-src is limited to named origins, object-src is 'none', and base-uri and form-action are 'self'.

column3: CSP: Wildcard Directive / CSP: style-src unsafe-inline

column1: # disposition: Informational, accepted by Mark Almeida-Cardy 2026-11-15. ZAP is only labelling responses as storable or non-storable. Cache-Control is set on purpose by the $cache_control map in nginx.conf.

column3: Non-Storable / Storable and Cacheable / Storable but Non-Cacheable Content
